name: rt_scene_lightwell
subject: this is one 320 x 240 game screen of the level. Turn every grey shape into finished art at exactly its position and size: walkable tops stay exactly where the grey tops are, gaps stay gaps, nothing moves, nothing is added in the dog's path. BOX A (the box at bottom left, top-left corner at game pixel (8, 168), exactly 96 x 72 game pixels): the back wall of the light well: the narrow gap between the two houses, from x 8 to x 104, from the tiles down to the bottom of the screen; part of the backdrop behind the play line. Look: we look straight at the flat back wall of a deeper house between the two front houses: grey-green plaster (#8FA08A lit, #74866F body, #5A6857 shade), two small square windows with dark frames (#3A3840) and dark panes (#2B3038) one above the other, a black downpipe down its right side; the wall gets one shade darker in a flat band below y 200 (a hard step); no side walls of the well visible, only the vertical edges of the two front houses at x 8 and x 104. BOX B (the box at bottom left, top-left corner at game pixel (0, 168), exactly 8 x 72 game pixels): the corner of the left house, its sandstone parapet cap the dog can stand on at y 168; part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: rust-red plaster (#B0503E lit, #8E3E32 body, #6B2E28 shade) with a sandstone parapet cap 6 px tall along its top (sandstone #CCAE8B lit top row, #A28B75, #7F685F, #473B39); 1 px dark outline #2D2224 where it meets the sky and the well. BOX C (the box at bottom left, top-left corner at game pixel (12, 168), exactly 88 x 6 game pixels): three loose roof tiles lying across the well (game pieces the dog jumps on); the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: keep the three orange bars exactly as they are (they are game sprites drawn by the game); under them one thin black iron rail (2 px, #3A3840) spans the well from x 8 to x 104 at y 174, fixed into both house corners. BOX D (the box at top left, top-left corner at game pixel (0, 72), exactly 80 x 6 game pixels): two loose tiles high up at the left, on a rod between two thin iron poles standing in the light well; the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: keep the two orange bars exactly; under them a thin black iron rod (2 px) from x 0 to x 76 at y 78, held by two thin black iron poles (2 px wide) at x 6 and x 70 that go straight down into the light well behind the lower tiles; nothing else up there. BOX E (the box at top middle, top-left corner at game pixel (104, 72), exactly 96 x 6 game pixels): a timber walkway board above the flat roof (the dog stands on it), on two iron posts standing on the roof; the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: a plank of weathered timber 6 px tall (#9A7251 lit top row, #75523E body, #623E2C bottom row, plank joints every 24 px), 1 px dark outline #2D2224; two thin black iron posts (2 px wide, #3A3840) under it at x 112 and x 192 from y 78 down to the roof at y 168; the dog keeps standing on it exactly where it is. BOX F (the box at top right, top-left corner at game pixel (232, 40), exactly 64 x 6 game pixels): a second timber board high up at the right, over the gable, on one iron post; the dog stands on it or bumps into it. Look: the same timber plank as E, 1 px dark outline; one thin black iron post (2 px) under its middle at x 262 from y 46 down to the gable slope. BOX G (the box at bottom middle, top-left corner at game pixel (104, 168), exactly 128 x 72 game pixels): the light-yellow house front under the flat roof (x 104 to 232): its parapet cap is the walk line at y 168; part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: a sandstone parapet cap 7 px tall along the top edge (sandstone #CCAE8B lit top row, #A28B75, #7F685F, #473B39), a 2 px darker shadow band under it; light-yellow plaster wall (#EBC86E lit, #D9AE52 body, #B88E3E shade, #8F6B2E darkest); three tall windows evenly spaced, each 14 px wide and 26 px tall with dark green wooden shutters on both sides (#4F7A5A, #3B5C44) and a sandstone sill; 1 px dark outline #2D2224 where the cap meets the sky. BOX H (the box at bottom right, top-left corner at game pixel (232, 104), exactly 88 x 136 game pixels): the gable end of the same house, facing us: the triangle from x 232 at y 168 up to its peak at x 296, y 104 and down past the right edge; part of the roof the dog walks on. Look: a flat light-yellow plaster triangle (same plaster as G); along its two sloping top edges a 4 px band of dark grey sheet-metal roof seen exactly edge-on (#5A5E68 top row, #4A4E57, #3A3E46), no roof surface visible; one small round attic window (10 px) centred under the peak; the dog walks up the slope, so the slope line stays exactly where the grey slope is; 1 px dark outline #2D2224 along the slopes. BOX I (the box at bottom middle, top-left corner at game pixel (0, 108), exactly 320 x 60 game pixels): the far town behind, in the sky area above the roofs; part of the backdrop behind the play line. Look: a flat silhouette band of distant rooftops, only where the sky shows: dark grey metal roofs and a few copper-green ones, plain chimneys, NO church spire, NO tower; lighter and less contrasted than the near houses; flat fills, 6 to 8 colours; the sky above in three flat warm bands; the clouds may stay as they are. EXACTLY ONE DOG: the black dog stays exactly as it is, unchanged, not mirrored, not moved, in its box (top-left at game pixel (174, 36), 52 x 38); draw no other dog or animal
extra: This scene has its own look, different from the rest of the level: a light-yellow house with dark green shutters, a rust-red neighbour, a grey-green light well wall, dark grey metal roofs. Do NOT add: a church spire or tower, glass skylights, a green copper canopy, a stone hotel front, red clay tile roofs, clay chimney pots, bones, a goose, or anything else not listed. Warm late afternoon light from the left, drawn as flat shade shapes. Image 2 is a small crop of the approved painting of this level: take from it ONLY the pixel size, the dark outlines, the flat shading and the crispness; not its colours, buildings, roofs, chimneys or layout. VIEW: a strict flat front elevation, like an architect's front drawing: the viewer looks straight at the front face of every object; no top surfaces, no side faces, no 3/4 view, no perspective, no vanishing points, no tilted or converging lines; every horizontal edge exactly horizontal, every vertical edge exactly vertical; round things show as flat-fronted upright shapes whose roundness is only flat shade bands; roofs are flat bands or triangles with no roof surface going back; steps are a sawtooth outline of risers; the ground is one flat band. Light from the upper left; depth only by flat shade bands (lit left edge, shaded right edge, a darker band under every overhang). PIXEL GRID: Image 1 is a 320 x 240 game frame shown at 4x; the result is reduced back to that size, so draw exactly on Image 1's pixel grid: every pixel square, the size of the dog's pixels, aligned to the same grid; one flat colour per pixel; no anti-aliasing, no in-between edge colours, no dithering, no texture noise, no lone specks; straight lines exactly straight; nothing smudged or painterly. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
